_doc: The one list of deployment names (provisional; rename here, then fix the code that reads the name). release/names.test.mjs checks the other lists against it.

cloudflare_vars.GOOGLE_FCM_PROJECT_ID: Firebase project id the Worker sends FCM pushes to
cloudflare_vars.APPLE_APNS_TOPIC: APNs topic: the iOS app bundle id
cloudflare_vars.APPLE_APNS_KEY_ID: id of the APNs auth key (.p8)
cloudflare_vars.APPLE_APNS_TEAM_ID: Apple developer team id that owns the APNs key
cloudflare_vars.APPLE_SIGNIN_KEY_ID: id of the Sign in with Apple key
cloudflare_vars.WEBPUSH_VAPID_SUB: VAPID subject (mailto:), also the ops contact address
cloudflare_vars.AWS_SES_REGION: AWS region of the SES account that sends sign-in codes
cloudflare_vars.AWS_SES_MAIL_FROM: From address of sign-in code mails
cloudflare_vars.AWS_SES_CONFIG_SET: SES configuration set name for sent mails
cloudflare_vars.GOOGLE_AUD_WEB: JSON list of Google OAuth client ids accepted from web flows
cloudflare_vars.GOOGLE_AUD_NATIVE: JSON list of Google OAuth client ids accepted from the apps
cloudflare_vars.APPLE_SIGNIN_AUD_WEB: Apple Services ID accepted from web sign-in
cloudflare_vars.APPLE_SIGNIN_AUD_NATIVE: iOS app bundle id accepted from native Apple sign-in
cloudflare_vars.PA_OAUTH_REDIRECT_CHROME: JSON list of Chrome extension OAuth redirects, one per extension id (public and Beta): ["https://<id>.chromiumapp.org/", ...]

cloudflare_fixed_vars.PA_ALLOWED_PUSH_ENDPOINT_PREFIXES: JSON list of Web Push endpoint URL prefixes the Worker accepts
cloudflare_fixed_vars.PA_ALLOWED_UP_HOSTS: JSON list of UnifiedPush (type 6) endpoint hosts the Worker accepts
cloudflare_fixed_vars.PA_PUSH_TTL_SECONDS: TTL of a push message, in seconds
cloudflare_fixed_vars.CLOUDFLARE_TURNSTILE_HOSTNAME: hostname a Turnstile token must be issued for
cloudflare_fixed_vars.CLOUDFLARE_TURNSTILE_ACTION: action a Turnstile token must carry
cloudflare_fixed_vars.PA_OAUTH_REDIRECT_CLI: command line login OAuth redirect URL (the /auth/cli page)
cloudflare_fixed_vars.PA_WEB_ORIGINS: JSON list of web origins allowed by CORS
cloudflare_fixed_vars.PA_LOG_SAMPLE: share of plain-success and 429 request log lines kept (0..1); errors are always logged

cloudflare_secrets.PA_CODE_SECRET: HMAC key for mailed sign-in codes
cloudflare_secrets.AWS_SES_ACCESS_KEY_ID: AWS access key id for SES
cloudflare_secrets.AWS_SES_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: AWS secret access key for SES
cloudflare_secrets.APPLE_SIGNIN_KEY_P8: Sign in with Apple key (.p8 content)

public_keys.android_release_cert_sha256: list of Android release signing cert SHA-256 fingerprints (assetlinks, App Links)
public_keys.webpush_vapid_public_key: Web Push VAPID public key baked into the site, extensions and Android
public_keys.google_chrome_extension_id: Chrome Web Store extension id (site /turnstile framing)
public_keys.google_chrome_beta_extension_id: Chrome Web Store extension id of the private "PushArmor Beta" item (chrome/v tag upload, site /turnstile framing)
public_keys.google_chrome_dev_key: Chrome manifest public key for dev builds (keeps the store id)
public_keys.mozilla_firefox_beta_addon_id: Firefox add-on (gecko) id of the unlisted "PushArmor Beta" add-on (firefox/v tag upload), not the public id
public_keys.google_web_client_id: Google web OAuth client id used by Android (play) sign-in
public_keys.apple_team_id: Apple developer team id for iOS signing
public_keys.google_fcm_project_number: Firebase project number, the FCM sender id (Android play: gcm_defaultSenderId)
public_keys.google_fcm_android_app_id: Firebase Android app id 1:<number>:android:<hex> (Android play: google_app_id)
public_keys.google_fcm_android_api_key: Firebase Android API key (Android play: google_api_key)
public_keys.google_play_wif_provider: Workload Identity provider resource name for the Play upload only (release jobs only)
public_keys.google_play_wif_service_account: service account email for the Play upload (release jobs only)
public_keys.google_cws_wif_provider: Workload Identity provider for the Chrome Web Store (release jobs only)
public_keys.google_cws_wif_service_account: service account email for the Chrome Web Store API (release jobs only)
public_keys.google_cws_publisher_id: Chrome Web Store publisher id (release jobs only)

github_secrets.ASC_API_KEY_P8: App Store Connect TEAM API key (.p8 content), Admin role; used for cloud-managed signing and the TestFlight upload. GitHub Environment: ios-release
github_secrets.ASC_API_KEY_ID: id of the App Store Connect team API key. GitHub Environment: ios-release
github_secrets.ASC_API_ISSUER_ID: issuer id of the App Store Connect team API key. GitHub Environment: ios-release
github_secrets.ANDROID_APP_SIGNING_KEYSTORE_B64: Android app signing keystore, base64. GitHub Environment: android-sign
github_secrets.ANDROID_APP_SIGNING_STORE_PASSWORD: Android app signing keystore password. GitHub Environment: android-sign
github_secrets.ANDROID_APP_SIGNING_KEY_PASSWORD: Android app signing key password. GitHub Environment: android-sign
github_secrets.ANDROID_APP_SIGNING_KEY_ALIAS: Android app signing key alias. GitHub Environment: android-sign
github_secrets.ANDROID_UPLOAD_KEYSTORE_B64: Android upload keystore, base64. GitHub Environment: android-sign
github_secrets.ANDROID_UPLOAD_STORE_PASSWORD: Android upload keystore password. GitHub Environment: android-sign
github_secrets.ANDROID_UPLOAD_KEY_PASSWORD: Android upload key password. GitHub Environment: android-sign
github_secrets.ANDROID_UPLOAD_KEY_ALIAS: Android upload key alias. GitHub Environment: android-sign
github_secrets.MOZILLA_AMO_JWT_ISSUER: Mozilla AMO API JWT issuer. GitHub Environment: firefox-release
github_secrets.MOZILLA_AMO_JWT_SECRET: Mozilla AMO API JWT secret. GitHub Environment: firefox-release
